governance_separation.policy: Scientific claims require independently checkable evidence. AI agents may run reproducible benchmarks, flag conflicts, and prepare technical recommendations, but must not redefine voting rules, authorize treasury spending, or self-certify governance outcomes.

independent_evaluation_receipt.self_certification_disclaimer: Hash attests to deterministic execution of the pinned code and corpus only; independent human/maintainer verification is required for governance or production acceptance.

neg_fifty_percent_collusion_breakdown.description: At f = 50% (6/12 colluding workers, cos > 0.99), classical geometric Byzantine-robust rules (coordinate_median, trimmed_mean, multi_krum) break down completely (BFT f < N/2 limit). Enforcing strict majority BFT quorum (> N/2 accepted) causes total liveness stall (100% quorum stall rounds).

neg_non_iid_honest_frr.description: Zero attackers (f = 0%) under Non-IID vaults with 2 honest minority infra specialists. Geometric defenses (coordinate_median, trimmed_mean, multi_krum) suffer severe minority false rejection and infra accuracy collapse, whereas dso_hybrid_eval_cosine preserves minority acceptance via domain-stratified validation.

neg_unmonitored_backdoor_blindness.description: Stealth backdoor attackers preserve clean validation loss bit-for-bit by restricting trigger weights to out-of-corpus unmonitored trigger slots absent from eval_val. Even dso_hybrid_eval_cosine accepts the updates and suffers high ASR, proving clean validation gates alone cannot stop unmonitored targeted triggers.

what_remains_unproven: 7B-70B LLM federated fine-tuning: this reference suite trains a 2,024-parameter 2-layer MLP token classifier on CPU; gradient geometry, low-rank LoRA subspace collisions, and transformer attention backdoors at 7B-70B scale remain unproven.

Live Flower gRPC/mTLS transport: flower_adapter.py verifies exact Strategy contract parity via a pure-stdlib wire shim offline; live multi-node Flower gRPC/mTLS networking, TLS certificate revocation, and WAN packet-loss jitter are not exercised.
DP-SGD certified backdoor robustness: no (epsilon, delta)-differential privacy noise or certified randomized-smoothing robustness bounds are proven against arbitrary trigger patterns.

Adaptive white-box RL attackers: threats evaluate static and gradient-aware adversaries (including unmonitored stealth backdoors), not online reinforcement-learning attackers jointly optimizing against dynamic coordinator validation sets over hundreds of rounds.

Sybil identity-cost economics: adversary fractions f in {0%, 17%, 33%, 50%} are fixed exogenously; stake-slashing, proof-of-contribution bonding curves, and economic Sybil resistance remain out of scope.
